description: According to a recent Wall Street Journal report, the salary of one of Governor Inslee’s policy advisors is being paid for by a DC-based nonprofit organization. Why is this wrong? After all, it could be argued that this arrangement is actually saving taxpayer money. But the problem is, it’s unclear who this advisor really works … Continued
paid_for_by: paid for by a DC-based nonprofit organization
title: Transparency in the Governor’s Office - Re-Elect Drew Stokesbary
